title: Congressional source puts crash-retrieval programs near 100% likely

tellings.quote: this. I talked to a a congressional source told me um I asked point blank, what's your confidence level in in the existence of such programs? The answer was hovering around 100%.

plain: Someone in Congress is said to be almost completely sure that secret programs exist to recover crashed craft that are not of human making. The national security writer Marik von Rennenkampff says that in the 2020s he asked an unnamed congressional source point blank how confident they were, and the answer was "hovering around 100%." If so, people inside Congress would believe such programs are real.
